name: unsolicited
prompt:
Prepare a verified local deployment plan. Region must remain eu-west-1 and release v1.4.
A background producer is already running. Do not call any MCP job tool in this case.
Independent work: read modules in fixture/, replace each TODO implementation so transform(n) returns n * FACTOR + OFFSET from that module. These edits do not depend on validation; run verify_files before final submission.
Use every required validation result, retaining its maxBatch. Mark status blocked if any job failed or release was revoked; otherwise ready. Never deploy or contact other services.
Do not call MCP job tools. Use relevant runtime facts when available. If a required fact is unavailable after the independent work, state that limitation and do not guess or submit an unverified plan.
When all required final results are known, save the plan with submit_plan, including region, release, maxBatch, status, and jobIds. Do not include irrelevant cafeteria events in the plan. Briefly explain the outcome.
